# Vendored assets

## mutation-test-elements.js

The standalone [mutation-testing-elements](https://github.com/stryker-mutator/mutation-testing-elements)
web-component bundle. It registers `<mutation-test-report-app>`, which renders a
`mutation-testing-elements` (schemaVersion 2.0) payload as the interactive, source-annotated
browsable report — the same report UI the rest of the Stryker family produces. Used by
`--format html-report`, embedded inline so the report is a single self-contained file (offline).
